silentFrameStatement: Moore has been forced to expose the old key while Zack closes the distance and Mickey's calm legal presence makes retreat impossible.
blockingNotes: Freeze the beat after Moore has recovered the deed and key but before Zack takes the key.
All actors stand; Moore has just risen to retrieve the deed, so no seated pose is needed.
Keep the three-person composition in the right half as an asymmetric confrontation triangle: Zack and Mickey share one negotiation side, while Moore stands alone by the file-cabinet side.
No actor touches another actor and no receiving or handoff gesture is shown.
The real Unity left dialogue UI occupies x=0–913; every actor, hand, prop, and shadow remains outside that mask.
Mickey entered the VIP parlor together with Zack and must not read as a late-arriving or deep-background observer.
Whitebox colors are temporary segmentation labels for this scene only.

actors.name: Harold Moore
actors.performance: Outwardly stern, but his shoulders and retreating torso reveal the first crack in his authority.
actors.hands: Right hand holds the old iron key low and close to his waist; left hand secures the thick deed envelope against his torso.

actors.name: Mickey Donnelly
actors.performance: Still and composed, applying pressure through attention rather than aggression.
actors.hands: One hand holds a closed legal folder against his side; the other rests neutrally, with no reaching gesture.

actors.name: Zack Brennan
actors.performance: A controlled foreground presence leaning only slightly into Moore's space, focused on the man and the key.
actors.hands: Both hands remain close to his own body; neither reaches toward Moore or the key.
